CREATE TABLE learning_goal_version (
    goal_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    graph_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'DEPRECATED')),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at timestamptz,
    PRIMARY KEY (goal_code, version),
    UNIQUE (goal_code, graph_version),
    CHECK ((status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL) OR status <> 'PUBLISHED')
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_goal_one_published_idx
    ON learning_goal_version(goal_code) WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED';

CREATE TABLE learning_target (
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('concept', 'capability')),
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (target_type, target_key, target_version),
    CHECK (target_key ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]{0,254}$')
);

CREATE TABLE learning_goal_target (
    goal_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    goal_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    module_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    module_title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    module_order integer NOT NULL CHECK (module_order >= 0),
    section_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    section_title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    section_order integer NOT NULL CHECK (section_order >= 0),
    lesson_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    lesson_title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    lesson_excerpt text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    lesson_order integer NOT NULL CHECK (lesson_order >= 0),
    PRIMARY KEY (goal_code, goal_version, target_type, target_key, target_version),
    FOREIGN KEY (goal_code, goal_version) REFERENCES learning_goal_version(goal_code, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    FOREIGN KEY (target_type, target_key, target_version)
        REFERENCES learning_target(target_type, target_key, target_version) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE target_prerequisite (
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    prerequisite_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    prerequisite_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    prerequisite_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (
        target_type, target_key, target_version,
        prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version
    ),
    FOREIGN KEY (target_type, target_key, target_version)
        REFERENCES learning_target(target_type, target_key, target_version) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    FOREIGN KEY (prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version)
        REFERENCES learning_target(target_type, target_key, target_version) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CHECK (
        (target_type, target_key, target_version) <>
        (prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version)
    )
);

CREATE TABLE transition_knowledge (
    source_stack varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    similarity text NOT NULL,
    difference text NOT NULL,
    analogy_boundary text NOT NULL,
    common_mistakes_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(common_mistakes_json) = 'array'),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (source_stack, target_type, target_key, target_version),
    FOREIGN KEY (target_type, target_key, target_version)
        REFERENCES learning_target(target_type, target_key, target_version) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE pedagogy_strategy_version (
    code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),
    status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'DEPRECATED')),
    config_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(config_json) = 'object'),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at timestamptz,
    PRIMARY KEY (code, version),
    CHECK ((status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL) OR status <> 'PUBLISHED')
);

CREATE TABLE pedagogy_profile_version (
    code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),
    status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'DEPRECATED')),
    config_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(config_json) = 'object'),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at timestamptz,
    PRIMARY KEY (code, version),
    CHECK ((status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL) OR status <> 'PUBLISHED')
);

CREATE TABLE pedagogy_profile_strategy (
    profile_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    profile_version integer NOT NULL,
    strategy_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    strategy_version integer NOT NULL,
    priority integer NOT NULL,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    PRIMARY KEY (profile_code, profile_version, strategy_code, strategy_version),
    FOREIGN KEY (profile_code, profile_version)
        REFERENCES pedagogy_profile_version(code, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    FOREIGN KEY (strategy_code, strategy_version)
        REFERENCES pedagogy_strategy_version(code, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE presentation_style_version (
    code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),
    status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'DEPRECATED')),
    config_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(config_json) = 'object'),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at timestamptz,
    PRIMARY KEY (code, version),
    CHECK ((status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL) OR status <> 'PUBLISHED')
);

CREATE TABLE generation_policy_version (
    code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),
    status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'DEPRECATED')),
    config_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(config_json) = 'object'),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at timestamptz,
    PRIMARY KEY (code, version),
    CHECK ((status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL) OR status <> 'PUBLISHED')
);

CREATE TABLE planner_policy_activation (
    slot varchar(64) PRIMARY KEY CHECK (slot = 'course_planning'),
    pedagogy_profile_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    pedagogy_profile_version integer NOT NULL,
    presentation_style_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    presentation_style_version integer NOT NULL,
    generation_policy_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    generation_policy_version integer NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    FOREIGN KEY (pedagogy_profile_code, pedagogy_profile_version)
        REFERENCES pedagogy_profile_version(code, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    FOREIGN KEY (presentation_style_code, presentation_style_version)
        REFERENCES presentation_style_version(code, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    FOREIGN KEY (generation_policy_code, generation_policy_version)
        REFERENCES generation_policy_version(code, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE course_plan_request (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL,
    request_hash char(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    goal_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    intent_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(intent_json) = 'object'),
    status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PLANNING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED')),
    result_code varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    course_id uuid,
    reused boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    course_fingerprint char(64) CHECK (course_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    fingerprint_version varchar(64),
    normalized_context_json jsonb,
    generated_course_json jsonb CHECK (generated_course_json IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(generated_course_json) = 'object'),
    failure_code varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
    claim_token uuid,
    lease_until timestamptz,
    next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    completed_at timestamptz,
    UNIQUE (student_id, idempotency_key),
    CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
    CHECK ((claim_token IS NULL) = (lease_until IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((course_fingerprint IS NULL) = (fingerprint_version IS NULL)),
    CHECK (status <> 'COMPLETED' OR completed_at IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE INDEX course_plan_request_worker_idx
    ON course_plan_request(next_attempt_at, created_at)
    WHERE status = 'PLANNING';

CREATE INDEX course_plan_request_student_idx
    ON course_plan_request(student_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE planner_outbox (
    event_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    subject varchar(200) NOT NULL CHECK (subject IN ('course.plan.completed', 'course.plan.failed')),
    schema_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version = 1),
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    correlation_id varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    causation_id varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    payload jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'),
    attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
    next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    locked_by varchar(128),
    locked_until timestamptz,
    published_at timestamptz,
    last_error varchar(2000),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((locked_by IS NULL) = (locked_until IS NULL)),
    CHECK (payload->>'event_id' = event_id::text),
    CHECK (payload->>'event_type' = subject),
    CHECK (payload->>'student_id' = student_id::text)
);

CREATE INDEX planner_outbox_pending_idx ON planner_outbox(next_attempt_at, occurred_at)
WHERE published_at IS NULL;
